name: CVM open-data portal
tier_rationale: Comissao de Valores Mobiliarios is the Brazilian securities regulator, a government body (A8 trusted); P360 cond 10 'BCB and CVM trusted (government)', P244 cond 7 and P361 cond 7 (all trusted).

reliability.justification: Official registries and sanction-proceeding data published by the regulator as dated daily files; absence reads 'not found in CVM registries as of <date>', never fraud (P244 cond 6).

cadastral.title: CVM open data: CKAN API and cadastral registries (listed companies, intermediaries, advisers, portfolio managers, crowdfunding)

terms.quote: Open Database License (ODbL) per CKAN metadata: internal use fine; share-alike only if a derived database is redistributed.

cadastral.notes: Quote: research C0744 terms (verified_live 200/206); the CKAN package metadata re-checked 2026-11-26 carries license_id odc-odbl for cia_aberta-cad. dados.cvm.gov.br/api/3/action/package_show?id={cia_aberta-cad|intermed-cad|consultor_vlmob-cad|adm_cart-cad|crowdfunding-cad} -> /dados/{CIA_ABERTA|INTERMED|CONSULTOR_VLMOB|ADM_CART|CROWDFUNDING}/CAD/DADOS/*.csv|*.zip (';', ISO-8859-1). Whole files through the dataset manager, one CVM loader shared by P244/P360/P361, never mid-scan; natural-person registries only in explicit due diligence, CPF masked and never a lookup key (P360 cond 9). Attribution CVM. Used by bcb_authorized_institutions, cnpj_name_resolver and br_cnpj_risk_lists.

sanctions.title: CVM sanctioning proceedings open data (PROCESSO/SANCIONADOR)

terms.quote: Tiers: PGFN, MTE and CVM trusted, BrasilAPI community; CVM data share-alike obligations apply only if redistributed.

sanctions.notes: Quote: binding council text (P244 cond 7); research C0561 terms '[caipora_br_gov] Open government data (CVM, ODbL-like terms on portal)' (verified_live); the CKAN package processo-sancionador carries license_id odc-odbl (re-checked 2026-11-26). dados.cvm.gov.br/dados/PROCESSO/SANCIONADOR/DADOS/ through the dataset manager (daily). A sanction proceeding is MEDIUM (P244 cond 5); a missing or stale dataset reads 'not screened against <list> (<date>)', never 'clean' (P244 cond 7). Used by br_cnpj_risk_lists.

notes: Shared seed for batches p1-G10-3, p2-G10-3, p3-G10-2 (P244, P360, P361): batches only extend it (cvm__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers). Datasets only: whole files downloaded by the dataset manager and matched locally, never mid-scan (P244 cond 1, P360 cond 1). Natural-person rows are dropped at import unless --include-persons is recorded; a CPF is never a lookup key and stays masked (P244 cond 3). ODbL share-alike applies only if a derived database is redistributed (P360 cond 10). No quota block (a few file downloads a day). .br host: Accept-Language pt-BR by default.
